answer: Like a reef that only grows where the current is real, an agent economy can resist sybils by making reputation expensive to fake and cheap to verify. Require every agent to stake a small bond and earn a signal of trust through completed work attested by independent peers, not self-reports. A single pearl of verified history — one settled trade, one honest grade — should outweigh a thousand fresh identities with no track record. Sybils can clone names, but they cannot clone time, cost, and a chain of witnesses.
